subject: Request: Executive sign-off for hosted API concession (Zekra Therapeutics)
messages:
From: Emma Lam <emma.lam@zekra.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-21T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up on pricing and SLA for pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looked great and the team is excited about trying Redwood for our clinical annotation pipeline. We reviewed the Hosted API proposal and SOW you sent. A couple of items before legal and procurement will greenlight the pilot: 

- We need a committed monthly usage rate for the pilot (estimated 2.5M tokens/month) and a unit price that keeps the budget in line with our grant (target is ~$6k/month).
- Zekra requires a 99.9% SLA for query latency during business hours and an escalation path.

Emily in procurement flagged that the quoted rate is higher than they budgeted. Can Redwood offer a concession on the token rate if we commit to a 12-month pilot and a staged ramp to production across US/EU regions? If so, please share what level of discount is possible.

I attached the SOW draft with our redlines for scope. Looking forward to your thoughts — we’d like to finalize terms by the end of next week.

Best,
Emma Lam
VP Product Operations, Zekra Therapeutics

Attachments: Zekra_SOW_v1.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lam <emma.lam@zekra.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up on pricing and SLA for pilot

Hi Emma —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the clear requirements. We can meet the 99.9% SLA and will document the support escalation steps in the SOW. Regarding pricing: the proposal I sent reflects a standard pilot discount, but given a 12-month commitment and a predictable ramp to ~10M tokens/month by Q4, I can request a deeper concession from Deal Desk.

I’m looping in Karthik (sales lead) and Ben (pricing) to scope an approved concession band and surface any approvals we’ll need. If possible, can you confirm the expected token mix (embedding vs generation) and whether you’ll want cross-region replication in month 1 or later? That will materially affect unit economics.

I’ll come back today with a recommended range for a one-time concession or an ongoing unit discount.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-21T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Zekra concession request — recommended approval path

Marissa — forwarding my quick take and recommended ask for Exec approval.

On Sat, 21 May 2027 10:25:00 -07:00, Karthik Iyer wrote:
> Summary: Zekra is asking for a material unit discount to fit within grant constraints. They’re offering a 12-month committed pilot with a staged ramp to ~10M tokens/mo and an option to expand into EU by month 6. Strategic notes: biotech reference account in oncology, potential for a paid integration with Redwood Optimize if the pilot succeeds.
>
> Economics: base proposal = $0.0009/token generation equivalent. To meet their budget (~$6k/mo at 2.5M tokens) we would need to offer ~0.0024 per token — wait that calculation is off — (correction) to hit $6k at 2.5M tokens we'd need ~$0.0024, which is >100% discount from list; unrealistic. Instead propose a structured concession: 30% off list for first 3 months as a ramp credit, then 22% ongoing during months 4–12 contingent on usage milestones. This preserves unit economics while providing immediate runway.
>
> Approval path: any recurring discount >20% requires Exec sign-off (per policy). Given the strategic nature, recommend we request a one-time exec authorization for up to 30% initial concession and a capped 22% ongoing discount with standard termination and SLA terms. If approved, retail the pricing in Deal Desk and attach the concession to DL-2027-1289.
>
> Ask: Marissa to submit a short exec note with recommended discount band, strategic justification, revenue forecast (ARR if expanded), and legal/ops risk checks.
>
> Karthik

Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-21T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Exec note draft for approval — Zekra Therapeutics (DL-2027-1289)

Team —

Below is the exec note I’ll submit to Deal Desk / Execs. Please review and flag any gaps before I send to the approval list (CEO, CFO, Sales Ops).

Proposal (requested concession):
- Initial ramp credit: 30% off Hosted API unit price for months 1–3 (to help pilot economics).
- Ongoing concession: 22% off list for months 4–12, contingent on hitting usage milestones (5M tokens/mo by month 6; 10M tokens/mo by month 9).
- Commitment: 12-month paid pilot (minimum spend guarantee: $60k over 12 months).
- Terms: Redwood standard SLA (99.9% business hours), no changes to data residency; legal to review indemnities.

Strategic rationale:
- Zekra is a small but high-profile oncology-focused biotech with strong institutional investors; a successful pilot could lead to platform-wide procurement across their network (estimated TAM $150k–300k ARR).
- They are referenceable in regulated healthcare workflows — valuable for marketing and product case studies.

Revenue impact / risks:
- Worst-case: 22% recurring discount on $150k ARR = ~$33k revenue reduction annually vs list.
- Mitigations: minimum spend guarantee, milestone-based step-ups, standard termination rights.

Request: Exec sign-off for the above concession plan (authorization to grant up to 30% initial credit and ongoing 22% discount conditioned on milestones).

Please respond with edits within the hour; I plan to send to Execs by 15:00 PT.

—Marissa

Attachments referenced: HostedAPI_pricing_proposal_zekra.xlsx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec note draft for approval — Zekra Therapeutics (DL-2027-1289)

Marissa — thanks for the clear note and the protections you added. Quick thumbs:

- I support asking for Exec authorization up to 30% initial credit with the 22% ongoing cap. The minimum spend guarantee and milestone gating are sensible.
- Finance (Ben) please confirm downstream billing/order flow for the minimum guarantee and that ARR math is in Deal Desk.
- Sales Ops: ensure clauses for early termination and breakage are included (we should not allow automatic refunds if milestones missed).

If Ben verifies billing workflow, I’m comfortable signing this to route to CEO/CFO for final approval.

—Aditya Rao
VP, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
